title: BlueCloud Launcher 0.7.1 - Doc Cloud and Sheet Cloud
notes: Doc Cloud 1.0.0 and Sheet Cloud 0.1.0 are now available as free Windows alpha apps. Install, open and update them from the launcher, with squircle logos, signed release metadata, SHA-256 package verification and existing download/recovery controls. Updated app catalog and download systems; existing libraries and profiles are preserved.
